newsitem.title: USA: Ralcorp Holdings Inc Q4 Sept 30 loss [CORRECTED 16:30 GMT].
newsitem.headline: Ralcorp Holdings Inc Q4 Sept 30 loss [CORRECTED 16:30 GMT].

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)

NOTE: Q4 1996 includes $109.5 million pretax, or $68.8 million $2.09/share after-tax, impairment charge related to private label cereal and consumer hot cereal operations, and $4.2 million positive restructuring charge adjustment.

Q4 1995 loss includes $21.9 million pretax non-recurring charge, including $10.1 million for costs to exit industrial oats business and to close oat milling operations at Cedar Rapids, Iowa, and $11.8 million for impairment of consumer hot cereal assets.
Ralcorp also wrote off $1.5 million net of tax of small dollar accounts receivable in Q4 1995.
Q4 EPS profit $0.07 before impairment charge vs profit $0.09 before charges.
